_zh: 结局一 · 平凡即是喜乐

en: The end is near — 'Paranoia Illusion' is emerging
_zh: 终局将至 —— 偏执泡影正在浮现

en: Do not reveal any ending lines. The first run will always end here.
_zh: 不翻开任何一条结局线。第一次探索必定走到这里。

en: A faintly glowing bubble hung at the end of the deep sea. Mizuki shattered it and continued forward.
_zh: 深海尽头悬着一团微微发光的泡影。水月打碎了它，继续向前。

en: The bubble bursts. Mizuki returns to the shore, ready for a good meal to welcome tomorrow.
_zh: 泡影散了。水月回到岸上，准备好好吃一顿，迎接明天。

en: The end is near — the Knight walks toward the center of the Black Tide
_zh: 终局将至 —— 骑士走向了黑潮中心

en: Obtain Breath of the Tide in 'Fanatic's Delusion', and keep the Tide-Hunt Knight alive until 10:00.
_zh: 在「狂徒妄念」中得到海潮的气息，并让猎潮的骑士活到 10:00。
_note: 「狂徒妄念」本表译 Delusions of Lunacy，这里没对上

en: He charged out of the Black Tide on Rocinante, shielding you from the waves. At the end, he walked into the center of the Black Tide, becoming The Last Knight within the ice.
_zh: 他骑着罗辛南特从黑潮里冲出来，替你挡下潮水。到了尽头，他走进黑潮中心，在寒冰里成了最后的骑士。

en: A silent giant wave rose, and the Knight's roar was submerged in the silence. The disaster that destroyed Iberia descended once more, never to recede again.
_zh: 无声的巨浪升起，骑士的怒吼没入静谧。毁灭伊比利亚的灾难再次降临，不会再退去。
结局四 · 如星空般深蓝

en: The end is near — Caerula Arbor extends its roots
_zh: 终局将至 —— 深蓝之树伸出了根

en: Choose ''Caerula'?!' at the start, and answer during Ascension.
_zh: 在开端选择「“深蓝”？！」，并在升华中作出回答。

en: You led Mizuki into the experimental hub of Caerula Arbor. He gave his answer during his sublimation, and Izumik recalled its offspring in the deepest depths.
_zh: 你带着水月走进深蓝之树的实验中枢。升华时他给出了自己的回答，伊祖米克在最深处召回子代。

en: The descendant of evolution rises from the tides of Terra, piercing the clouds, heading for the sea of stars.
_zh: 进化的后裔从泰拉的潮水中升起，穿过云层，去往星海。

en: He still accepted the Seaborn as a human. The evolved descendants rose from the tides of Terra, heading toward the sea of stars.
_zh: 他仍以人的身份接受了海嗣。进化的后裔从泰拉的潮水中升起，去往星海。

en: He only did what he believed was right. The evolved descendants rose from the tides of Terra, heading toward the sea of stars.
_zh: 他只做自己认为对的事。进化的后裔从泰拉的潮水中升起，去往星海。

en: Instinct overwhelmed humanity, and he still doubted who he was. The evolved descendants rose from the tides of Terra, heading toward the sea of stars.
_zh: 本能压过了人性，他仍在怀疑自己是谁。进化的后裔从泰拉的潮水中升起，去往星海。
结局三 · 息潮的代价

en: The end is near — Ishar'mla awakens deep within We Many
_zh: 终局将至 —— 伊莎玛拉在大群深处苏醒

en: Choose 'Decide to dive into the deep sea' at the beginning, and find the Caerula Animus in the laboratory's garden.
_zh: 在开端选择「决定潜入深海」，并在实验室的园林里找到深蓝之心。
_note: 「决定潜入深海」本表译 Decide to dive into the abyss，这里没对上

en: You dove into that massive corpse and found Its Core organ in the center of the garden. Ishar'mla was waiting in the deepest depths.
_zh: 你们潜进那具巨大的尸骸，在园林中央找到了祂的核心器官。伊莎玛拉在最深处等着。

en: The silence recedes, the tide calms. Mizuki can never return to land.
_zh: 静谧退去，海潮平息。水月再也回不到陆地上。

en: The sky was burning, and the Knight galloped above the waves. Only the azure remained all around, and the wheat ears were calling.
_zh: 天空在燃烧，骑士驰骋在浪涛之上。四周只剩蔚蓝，麦穗在呼唤。

en: Leader Max HP -10%, obtain 'Breath of the Tide': Tide-Hunt Knight joins the squad. Proceed to Ending 2
_zh: 队长最大生命 -10%，得到「海潮的气息」：猎潮的骑士加入编队。走向结局二

en: 60% chance to obtain 'Breath of the Tide', otherwise nothing
_zh: 60% 得到「海潮的气息」，失败则一无所获

en: What exactly does he want to do?
Bad news came one after another. The documents Mizuki found recorded the bishop's plan, as well as a location called 'Caerula'.
_zh: 坏消息接踵而至。水月找到的文件里，记着主教的计划，还有一个叫「深蓝」的地点。

en: Decide to dive into the abyss
Obtain 'Bishop's Research': Merchant prices +15% hereafter. Go find the secret left by the bishop
_zh: 得到「主教的研究」：此后商人售价 +15%。去找主教留下的秘密

en: Obtain 'Caerula Memory': 1 Rejection Reaction. Follow this name all the way down
_zh: 得到「深蓝回忆」：一次排异反应。跟着这个名字一路向下

en: The ocean was silent as a mirror. The Knight shattered the mirror and looked at his reflection. His enemy was named Terra.
_zh: 海洋沉默如镜。骑士踏碎镜面，望向倒影里的自己。他的敌人，叫做泰拉。
队长生命 -15%，源石锭 +20（原作「荒诞命运」）

en: Obtain 'The Knight's Corpus': Final Boss takes +80% damage; when Tide-Hunt Knight is in squad, Leader also takes +80% damage.
_zh: 得到「骑士骨血」：最终 Boss 受到的伤害 +80%；猎潮的骑士在编队时，队长受到的伤害也 +80%

en: Better stay away from this madman...
A dusty laboratory is hidden within the massive corpse. The surveillance system recognizes your face and opens the gate. Every room requires some Originium Ingots to access.
_zh: 巨大的尸骸里藏着一座尘封的实验室。监控认出你的脸，打开了大门。每个房间都要花些源石锭打点。

en: Originium Ingot -8: Immediately recruit an Operator
_zh: 源石锭 -8：立即招募一名干员

en: Originium Ingot -8: Obtain a random Collectible
_zh: 源石锭 -8：随机获得一件藏品
源石锭 -8：回复 30% 最大生命

en: Originium Ingot -8: Choose 1 of 3 growth options
_zh: 源石锭 -8：获得一次成长三选一

en: Obtain 'Caerula Animus': 1 Rejection Reaction, Seaborn evolve faster. Proceed to Ending 3
_zh: 得到「深蓝之心」：一次排异反应，海嗣更快进化。走向结局三

en: Something is hidden here, but you decide not to touch it
_zh: 这里藏着什么，但你决定不去碰它

en: Beside Its resting place was an area untouched by the Seaborn: sea sand, broken statues, and a pair of sleeping beauties tightly gripping their weapons.
_zh: 祂的栖所旁有一片没被海嗣染指的地方：海砂、破损的人像，和一对紧握武器的睡美人。

en: Kiss the Hunters' foreheads and take their artifacts
_zh: 亲吻猎人们的额头并取走遗物

en: Obtain 'Last Refrain': Obtain 2 random Rare Collectibles
_zh: 得到「“绝唱”」：随机获得 2 件稀有藏品

en: Mizuki entered the transfer cabin leading to the bottom of the experimental hub. On the main console, those assimilated processes were still running.
_zh: 水月进了通往实验中枢底层的传输舱。主控台上，那些被同化的流程还开着。
灯火 +30，回复 30% 最大生命

en: Obtain 'Caerula Arbor': All enemies ATK speed +15%; Light +6 every 15s the Leader takes no damage.
_zh: 得到「深蓝之树」：所有敌人攻击速度 +15%；队长每 15 秒没有受伤，灯火 +6

en: The kin only seek survival, thus they evolve endlessly. Before welcoming the singularity of evolution, It who leads them must first answer: Who am I?
_zh: 族群唯求生存，所以演化不息。在迎接进化奇点之前，引领它们的祂要先回答：我，是谁？

en: 'I am Mizuki. I will fulfill the Doctor's request.'
_zh: “我是水月，我会完成博士的请求”

en: Obtain 'Determination': Leader Max HP +30%, Physical damage taken -2; 1 additional Elite spawns each time, Seaborn HP and damage +10%. Proceed to Ending 4.
_zh: 得到「“决心”」：队长最大生命 +30%、物理减伤 +2；精英每次多来 1 只，海嗣生命与伤害 +10%。走向结局四

en: Obtain 'Vigil': Level-ups and Collectibles become choose 1 of 4. Head towards Ending 4
_zh: 得到「“观望”」：升级与藏品改为四选一。走向结局四

en: 'We many is not me. I am we many.'
Obtain 'Hesitation': Rare / Core relic appearance rate +30%, pickup range -20%. Proceed to Ending 4.
_zh: 得到「“犹疑”」：稀有 / 核心藏品出现率 +30%，拾取范围 -20%。走向结局四

en: An Inquisitor who had lost his lantern leaned on his sword, panting on the coastal reef, his feet surrounded by Sea Seaborn corpses.
_zh: 一位失去提灯的审判官拄着剑，在岸边礁石上喘息，脚边满是恐鱼的尸体。

en: Phagocytic dust covered the entire city. Amidst the ruins, something glowed beneath the dust.
_zh: 噬尘覆盖了整座城市。废墟间，有什么东西在噬尘下发着光。

en: Take the risk to go retrieve it
Leader HP -15%, obtain a main branch Collectible
_zh: 队长生命 -15%，获得一件主流派藏品

en: Scavenge for supplies from a safe area
A lonely Sea Seaborn lay on the reef, its tentacles haphazardly plucking a human instrument, singing its final song.
_zh: 孤独的恐鱼趴在礁石上，触须胡乱拨着人类的乐器，唱着最后一支歌。

en: Originium Ingot -12, obtain a main branch Collectible
_zh: 源石锭 -12，获得一件主流派藏品

en: An Ægir stood against the tide. The giant waves nearly swallowed him several times, but he did not retreat a single step.
_zh: 一位阿戈尔人迎着潮头站立，巨浪几次险些吞没他，他半步也没退。

en: Take the risk to help him recover his equipment
Leader HP -15%, obtain a main branch Rare Collectible
_zh: 队长生命 -15%，获得一件主流派稀有藏品

en: Ask him about what he's seen
While sheltering from a storm, you stumble into a karst cave. Inside is an amalgamation of half a human and half a Sea Seaborn, draped in fragments of cleric robes.
_zh: 躲避风暴时，你闯进一个溶洞。里面是半个人和半只恐鱼拼成的东西，身上挂着教士服的残片。
队长生命 -30%，队长最大生命 +10%

en: Maybe it's a trap by the Church of the Deep cultists
_zh: 说不定是深海教徒的陷阱

en: Before the Profound Silence, tales of pirates circulated on the sea; legend had it that their wealth rivaled that of a nation.
_zh: 大静谧之前，海上流传着海盗的故事，传说他们的财富堪比一国。

en: Obtain a main branch Collectible and a Cursed Collectible
_zh: 获得一件主流派藏品和一件遭诅藏品

en: The Islanders brought you into the karst cave, prying open giant shells to collect secretions. The work was simple, and the pay was not bad.
_zh: 海民把你带进溶洞，撬开巨型贝壳收集分泌物。活很简单，报酬也不错。

en: The pay's great, so join in
Originium Ingot -3, 70% chance to obtain Originium Ingot +8
_zh: 源石锭 -3，70% 获得源石锭 +8

en: Originium Ingot -10, 50% chance to gain Originium Ingot +25
_zh: 源石锭 -10，50% 获得源石锭 +25

en: You chopped down a few strange trees with bark as smooth as skin for firewood. At nightfall, the campfire attracted many lost travelers.
_zh: 你砍了几棵树皮光滑如皮肤的怪树当柴。入夜，篝火引来了不少迷路的旅人。

en: Originium Ingot -5, choose 1 of 3 growth options
_zh: 源石锭 -5，获得一次成长三选一

en: Three new commissions appear on the terminal from Tulip, Rhodes Island's head of operations in Iberia. A line of fine print is attached to the end of each.
_zh: 终端上有三条新委托，发件人是罗德岛驻伊比利亚的总负责人郁金香。每条末尾都附了一行小字。

en: Take a look at the trickiest commission
Enemies spawned in the next 90s have HP and damage +30%, and an Elite squad will appear. Defeat the squad and survive until time ends: Choose 1 of 3 mainstream relics, Originium Ingot +15.
_zh: 接下来 90 秒刷出的敌人生命与伤害 +30%，并来一支精英小队。小队全灭且坚持到时间结束：主流派藏品三选一，源石锭 +15

en: Take a look at the mid-tier commission
_zh: 点开稍有挑战性的委托

en: Enemies spawned in the next 90s have HP and damage +20%. Survive until time ends: Run EXP +15%.
_zh: 接下来 90 秒刷出的敌人生命与伤害 +20%。坚持到时间结束：整局经验 +15%

en: Take a look at the simplest commission

_zh: 60 秒内击败 150 名敌人：源石锭 +10

en: A batch of support supplies has arrived at the nearest safehouse. You can leave it to the logistics department for transport, or dispatch an Operator familiar with the area to retrieve it.
_zh: 一批支援物资送到了最近的安全屋。可以交给后勤部门转运，也可以派一名熟悉周边的干员去接。

en: Select 1 squad member to leave the squad for 45s; upon returning, the Operator gains 1 Promotion level and brings back 1 main branch Basic relic
_zh: 选一名队友离队 45 秒；归队时该干员精英化一级，并带回一件主流派基础藏品

en: You found the Rhodes Island squad that initially sent the distress signal. They were also exploring the surroundings and were willing to exchange intel with you.
_zh: 你找到了最初发出求助信号的罗德岛小队。他们也在探索周边，愿意和你交换情报。

en: Select an Operator for an immediate Promotion (if Elite 2, choose 1 of 3 growths twice instead); select another teammate to evacuate with the vanguard squad, leaving the squad, but can be recruited again later.
_zh: 选一名干员立即精英化一级（已精英二改为两次成长三选一）；再选一名队友随先遣小队撤离，离开编队，之后可再招募

en: An Ægir holds an ocean current monitoring device, claiming it is a relic. He wants to exchange it for money to travel to the most powerful nation on land.
_zh: 一位阿戈尔人捧着一件监测洋流的仪器，说它是秘宝。他想换一笔钱，去陆上最强大的国家。

en: Lose all Originium Ingots, obtain a main branch Core Collectible
_zh: 消耗全部源石锭，获得一件主流派核心藏品

en: Leader HP -25%, obtain a main branch Rare Collectible
_zh: 队长生命 -25%，获得一件主流派稀有藏品

en: You rescue a robed Iberian from a swarm of Sea Seaborn. He offers several boxes in gratitude. You cannot tell if he is a cleric or a Church of the Deep cultist.
_zh: 你从恐鱼群里救下一个穿长袍的伊比利亚人。他捧出几只盒子答谢，你分不清他是教徒还是深海教徒。

en: Choose the box with a sword and gun
_zh: 选择印有剑与铳的盒子

en: Obtain a Melee Range Expansion / Weakness Harvesting / Multi-Projectile Firepower Collectible
_zh: 获得一件近战扩域 / 弱点收割 / 多弹火力藏品

en: Choose the box with a lantern
Obtain a Survival / Objective Shield Counter / Healing-to-Damage Collectible
_zh: 获得一件生存 / 护盾反击 / 治疗转伤藏品

en: Choose the box with hands clasped in prayer
_zh: 选择印有祈求双手的盒子

en: Obtain a Cursed Collectible, Originium Ingot +25
_zh: 获得一件遭诅藏品，源石锭 +25

en: Choose the box with interlocking keys
_zh: 选择印有交错密钥的盒子

en: Obtain a Cursed Collectible and a main branch Rare Collectible
_zh: 获得一件遭诅藏品和一件主流派稀有藏品

en: Don't ask for anything in return

An Ægir brings you into a shelter. Heavy rain falls outside; only the lantern in his hand is lit. Equipment left by the Inquisition sits on the shelves, which he is willing to trade for what you carry.
_zh: 一位阿戈尔人把你带进避难所。窗外大雨，只有他手里的提灯亮着。架上摆着审判庭留下的装备，他愿意拿来换你带的东西。

en: Hand over 1 relic (stats-only relics only), reveal 3 main branch relics of equal or higher rarity, and choose 1
_zh: 交出一件藏品（只能交纯属性藏品），从主流派亮出三件稀有度不低于它的藏品，选一件

en: In a karst cave, an old Artificer maintains two weapons taller than himself. He says Ægir has no hunters left, and tells you to pick one.
_zh: 溶洞里，一位老工匠在保养两把比他还高的武器。他说阿戈尔已经没有猎人了，让你挑一把。

en: Obtain a Melee Range Expansion Core Collectible
_zh: 获得一件近战扩域核心藏品

en: Obtain a Weakpoint Harvest Core Collectible
_zh: 获得一件弱点收割核心藏品

en: A squad of Iberian clerics walks by carrying a furnace, inside which a writhing Sea Seaborn is nailed. The leading cleric states that fire can kill all Seaborn.
_zh: 一队伊比利亚教士抬着火炉走过，炉里钉着一只还在扭动的恐鱼。为首的教士说，火焰能杀死所有海嗣。

en: Pray to the flames for your suffering operators
_zh: 为受苦的干员请求火焰

en: Promote 1 Operator immediately, Leader Max HP -10%
_zh: 选一名干员立即精英化一级，队长最大生命 -10%
火焰拯救不了这片大地

en: The next node is guaranteed to be an Emergency Operation, wipe out the enemy squad to drop two chests
_zh: 下一个路口必出一张紧急作战，小队全灭掉两个宝箱

en: Immediately face an Elite squad, defeat them to choose 1 of 3 main branch Collectibles
_zh: 立即来一支精英小队，全灭得主流派藏品三选一

en: Several unclaimed items lay on the table. An old custom says that passersby may Take one.
_zh: 桌上摆着几件没人认领的东西。旧习俗说，路过的人可以带走一件。

en: Choose 1 of 3 main branch Collectibles (Rare / Core weighted)
_zh: 主流派藏品三选一（稀有 / 核心加权）

en: Leader Max HP -10%, choose 1 of 3 main branch Collectibles twice
_zh: 队长最大生命 -10%，主流派藏品三选一两次

en: The Inquisition has tied ascetic rituals to heavy manual labor, offering rewards to those who complete them. Many sign up, but few make it to the end.
_zh: 审判庭把苦修仪式和重体力活绑在了一起，完成的人能领到奖赏。来报名的人不少，走完的没几个。
队长生命 -12%，队长最大生命 +4%

en: Transport building materials and fuel to the watchtower
_zh: 将石料与燃料运上瞭望塔

en: Leader HP -12%, obtain a main branch Collectible
_zh: 队长生命 -12%，获得一件主流派藏品

en: The fog sends you into the wreckage of a sunken ship. A group of kin stands on the cabin roof, conversing. You can hear that every voice is different.
_zh: 迷雾把你送进一艘沉船的残骸。舱顶上站着一群同胞，它们在交谈，你听得出每个声音都不一样。

en: Originium Ingot -10, ranged enemy attack interval +15%
_zh: 源石锭 -10，远程杂兵开火间隔 +15%

en: Leader Max HP -5%, Damage to Elites +12%
_zh: 队长最大生命 -5%，对精英伤害 +12%

en: Try to mingle in and join their conversation
Nervous Impairment buildup +25%, squad SP Recovery +8%
_zh: 神经损伤累积 +25%，全队技力回复 +8%

en: You infiltrate a settlement of Church of the Deep cultists. Sea Seaborn and humans coexist peacefully here, provided there is enough food and no one shows hostility.
_zh: 你混进了一处深海教徒的聚居地。恐鱼和人在这里相安无事，前提是食物管够，也没人露出敌意。

en: Leader HP -10%, then choose which to feed
_zh: 队长生命 -10%，再选喂哪一种

en: It'd be best to leave now
The food is ready. By the pool, in the Shallows, deep in the cave, things are waiting.
_zh: 食物备好了。水池边、浅滩上、洞穴深处，都有东西在等。

en: Feed the nethersea brand by the pool
Recruit an Operator (choose from 2 random classes)
_zh: 招募一名干员（从随机两个职业里选）

en: Leader HP -10%, 50% chance to feed again (can only feed one more time)
_zh: 队长生命 -10%，50% 再喂一次（只能再喂一次）

en: Feed the nethersea brand by the pool
Recruit an Operator (choose from 2 random classes)
_zh: 招募一名干员（从随机两个职业里选）

en: While searching for a messenger station, you meet a cleric returning to Iberia. He is willing to help you contact local Operators, but only handles the communication.
_zh: 寻找信使驿站时，你遇到一位要回伊比利亚的教士。他愿意帮你联络当地的干员，但只负责联络。

en: Originium Ingot -5, recruit an Operator (choose from 2 random classes)
_zh: 源石锭 -5，招募一名干员（从随机两个职业里选）
源石锭 -15，招募任意一名干员

en: An old Ægir is crafting equipment from Sea Seaborn corpses. He says he once worked in an academy studying the Seaborn, and now only wants to put his research to use.
_zh: 一位老阿戈尔人在用恐鱼的尸体做装备。他说自己待过研究海嗣的科学院，现在只想让研究派上用场。

en: Why not give it a try?
Obtain 1 Survival / Shield Counter Rare relic; 50% chance to also obtain 1 Cursed relic
_zh: 获得一件生存 / 护盾反击稀有藏品；50% 同时获得一件遭诅藏品

keys: 结局一 · 平凡即是喜乐
终局将至 —— 偏执泡影正在浮现
en: The end is near — 'Paranoia Illusion' is emerging

keys: 不翻开任何一条结局线。第一次探索必定走到这里。
en: Do not reveal any ending lines. The first run will always end here.

keys: 深海尽头悬着一团微微发光的泡影。水月打碎了它，继续向前。
en: A faintly glowing bubble hung at the end of the deep sea. Mizuki shattered it and continued forward.

keys: 泡影散了。水月回到岸上，准备好好吃一顿，迎接明天。
en: The bubble bursts. Mizuki returns to the shore, ready for a good meal to welcome tomorrow.

keys: 终局将至 —— 骑士走向了黑潮中心
en: The end is near — the Knight walks toward the center of the Black Tide

keys: 在「狂徒妄念」中得到海潮的气息，并让猎潮的骑士活到 10:00。
en: Obtain Breath of the Tide in 'Fanatic's Delusion', and keep the Tide-Hunt Knight alive until 10:00.

keys: 他骑着罗辛南特从黑潮里冲出来，替你挡下潮水。到了尽头，他走进黑潮中心，在寒冰里成了最后的骑士。
en: He charged out of the Black Tide on Rocinante, shielding you from the waves. At the end, he walked into the center of the Black Tide, becoming The Last Knight within the ice.

keys: 无声的巨浪升起，骑士的怒吼没入静谧。毁灭伊比利亚的灾难再次降临，不会再退去。
en: A silent giant wave rose, and the Knight's roar was submerged in the silence. The disaster that destroyed Iberia descended once more, never to recede again.

keys: 结局四 · 如星空般深蓝
终局将至 —— 深蓝之树伸出了根
en: The end is near — Caerula Arbor extends its roots

keys: 在开端选择「“深蓝”？！」，并在升华中作出回答。
en: Choose ''Caerula'?!' at the start, and answer during Ascension.

keys: 你带着水月走进深蓝之树的实验中枢。升华时他给出了自己的回答，伊祖米克在最深处召回子代。
en: You led Mizuki into the experimental hub of Caerula Arbor. He gave his answer during his sublimation, and Izumik recalled its offspring in the deepest depths.

keys: 进化的后裔从泰拉的潮水中升起，穿过云层，去往星海。
en: The descendant of evolution rises from the tides of Terra, piercing the clouds, heading for the sea of stars.

keys: 他仍以人的身份接受了海嗣。进化的后裔从泰拉的潮水中升起，去往星海。
en: He still accepted the Seaborn as a human. The evolved descendants rose from the tides of Terra, heading toward the sea of stars.

keys: 他只做自己认为对的事。进化的后裔从泰拉的潮水中升起，去往星海。
en: He only did what he believed was right. The evolved descendants rose from the tides of Terra, heading toward the sea of stars.

keys: 本能压过了人性，他仍在怀疑自己是谁。进化的后裔从泰拉的潮水中升起，去往星海。
en: Instinct overwhelmed humanity, and he still doubted who he was. The evolved descendants rose from the tides of Terra, heading toward the sea of stars.

keys: 结局三 · 息潮的代价
终局将至 —— 伊莎玛拉在大群深处苏醒
en: The end is near — Ishar'mla awakens deep within We Many

keys: 在开端选择「决定潜入深海」，并在实验室的园林里找到深蓝之心。
en: Choose 'Decide to dive into the deep sea' at the beginning, and find the Caerula Animus in the laboratory's garden.

keys: 你们潜进那具巨大的尸骸，在园林中央找到了祂的核心器官。伊莎玛拉在最深处等着。
en: You dove into that massive corpse and found Its Core organ in the center of the garden. Ishar'mla was waiting in the deepest depths.

keys: 静谧退去，海潮平息。水月再也回不到陆地上。
en: The silence recedes, the tide calms. Mizuki can never return to land.

keys: 天空在燃烧，骑士驰骋在浪涛之上。四周只剩蔚蓝，麦穗在呼唤。
en: The sky was burning, and the Knight galloped above the waves. Only the azure remained all around, and the wheat ears were calling.

keys: 队长最大生命 -10%，得到「海潮的气息」：猎潮的骑士加入编队。走向结局二
en: Leader Max HP -10%, obtain 'Breath of the Tide': Tide-Hunt Knight joins the squad. Proceed to Ending 2

keys: 60% 得到「海潮的气息」，失败则一无所获
en: 60% chance to obtain 'Breath of the Tide', otherwise nothing
What exactly does he want to do?

keys: 坏消息接踵而至。水月找到的文件里，记着主教的计划，还有一个叫「深蓝」的地点。
en: Bad news came one after another. The documents Mizuki found recorded the bishop's plan, as well as a location called 'Caerula'.
Decide to dive into the abyss

keys: 得到「主教的研究」：此后商人售价 +15%。去找主教留下的秘密
en: Obtain 'Bishop's Research': Merchant prices +15% hereafter. Go find the secret left by the bishop

keys: 得到「深蓝回忆」：一次排异反应。跟着这个名字一路向下
en: Obtain 'Caerula Memory': 1 Rejection Reaction. Follow this name all the way down

keys: 海洋沉默如镜。骑士踏碎镜面，望向倒影里的自己。他的敌人，叫做泰拉。
en: The ocean was silent as a mirror. The Knight shattered the mirror and looked at his reflection. His enemy was named Terra.

keys: 队长生命 -15%，源石锭 +20（原作「荒诞命运」）
得到「骑士骨血」：最终 Boss 受到的伤害 +80%；猎潮的骑士在编队时，队长受到的伤害也 +80%
en: Obtain 'The Knight's Corpus': Final Boss takes +80% damage; when Tide-Hunt Knight is in squad, Leader also takes +80% damage.
Better stay away from this madman...

keys: 巨大的尸骸里藏着一座尘封的实验室。监控认出你的脸，打开了大门。每个房间都要花些源石锭打点。
en: A dusty laboratory is hidden within the massive corpse. The surveillance system recognizes your face and opens the gate. Every room requires some Originium Ingots to access.

keys: 源石锭 -8：立即招募一名干员
en: Originium Ingot -8: Immediately recruit an Operator

keys: 源石锭 -8：随机获得一件藏品
en: Originium Ingot -8: Obtain a random Collectible

keys: 源石锭 -8：回复 30% 最大生命
源石锭 -8：获得一次成长三选一
en: Originium Ingot -8: Choose 1 of 3 growth options

keys: 得到「深蓝之心」：一次排异反应，海嗣更快进化。走向结局三
en: Obtain 'Caerula Animus': 1 Rejection Reaction, Seaborn evolve faster. Proceed to Ending 3

keys: 这里藏着什么，但你决定不去碰它
en: Something is hidden here, but you decide not to touch it

keys: 祂的栖所旁有一片没被海嗣染指的地方：海砂、破损的人像，和一对紧握武器的睡美人。
en: Beside Its resting place was an area untouched by the Seaborn: sea sand, broken statues, and a pair of sleeping beauties tightly gripping their weapons.

keys: 亲吻猎人们的额头并取走遗物
en: Kiss the Hunters' foreheads and take their artifacts

keys: 得到「“绝唱”」：随机获得 2 件稀有藏品
en: Obtain 'Last Refrain': Obtain 2 random Rare Collectibles

keys: 水月进了通往实验中枢底层的传输舱。主控台上，那些被同化的流程还开着。
en: Mizuki entered the transfer cabin leading to the bottom of the experimental hub. On the main console, those assimilated processes were still running.

keys: 灯火 +30，回复 30% 最大生命
得到「深蓝之树」：所有敌人攻击速度 +15%；队长每 15 秒没有受伤，灯火 +6
en: Obtain 'Caerula Arbor': All enemies ATK speed +15%; Light +6 every 15s the Leader takes no damage.

keys: 族群唯求生存，所以演化不息。在迎接进化奇点之前，引领它们的祂要先回答：我，是谁？
en: The kin only seek survival, thus they evolve endlessly. Before welcoming the singularity of evolution, It who leads them must first answer: Who am I?

keys: “我是水月，我会完成博士的请求”
en: 'I am Mizuki. I will fulfill the Doctor's request.'

keys: 得到「“决心”」：队长最大生命 +30%、物理减伤 +2；精英每次多来 1 只，海嗣生命与伤害 +10%。走向结局四
en: Obtain 'Determination': Leader Max HP +30%, Physical damage taken -2; 1 additional Elite spawns each time, Seaborn HP and damage +10%. Proceed to Ending 4.

keys: 得到「“观望”」：升级与藏品改为四选一。走向结局四
en: Obtain 'Vigil': Level-ups and Collectibles become choose 1 of 4. Head towards Ending 4
'We many is not me. I am we many.'

keys: 得到「“犹疑”」：稀有 / 核心藏品出现率 +30%，拾取范围 -20%。走向结局四
en: Obtain 'Hesitation': Rare / Core relic appearance rate +30%, pickup range -20%. Proceed to Ending 4.

keys: 一位失去提灯的审判官拄着剑，在岸边礁石上喘息，脚边满是恐鱼的尸体。
en: An Inquisitor who had lost his lantern leaned on his sword, panting on the coastal reef, his feet surrounded by Sea Seaborn corpses.

keys: 噬尘覆盖了整座城市。废墟间，有什么东西在噬尘下发着光。
en: Phagocytic dust covered the entire city. Amidst the ruins, something glowed beneath the dust.
Take the risk to go retrieve it

keys: 队长生命 -15%，获得一件主流派藏品
en: Leader HP -15%, obtain a main branch Collectible
Scavenge for supplies from a safe area

keys: 孤独的恐鱼趴在礁石上，触须胡乱拨着人类的乐器，唱着最后一支歌。
en: A lonely Sea Seaborn lay on the reef, its tentacles haphazardly plucking a human instrument, singing its final song.

keys: 源石锭 -12，获得一件主流派藏品
en: Originium Ingot -12, obtain a main branch Collectible

keys: 一位阿戈尔人迎着潮头站立，巨浪几次险些吞没他，他半步也没退。
en: An Ægir stood against the tide. The giant waves nearly swallowed him several times, but he did not retreat a single step.
Take the risk to help him recover his equipment

keys: 队长生命 -15%，获得一件主流派稀有藏品
en: Leader HP -15%, obtain a main branch Rare Collectible
Ask him about what he's seen

keys: 躲避风暴时，你闯进一个溶洞。里面是半个人和半只恐鱼拼成的东西，身上挂着教士服的残片。
en: While sheltering from a storm, you stumble into a karst cave. Inside is an amalgamation of half a human and half a Sea Seaborn, draped in fragments of cleric robes.

keys: 队长生命 -30%，队长最大生命 +10%
说不定是深海教徒的陷阱
en: Maybe it's a trap by the Church of the Deep cultists

keys: 大静谧之前，海上流传着海盗的故事，传说他们的财富堪比一国。
en: Before the Profound Silence, tales of pirates circulated on the sea; legend had it that their wealth rivaled that of a nation.

keys: 获得一件主流派藏品和一件遭诅藏品
en: Obtain a main branch Collectible and a Cursed Collectible

keys: 海民把你带进溶洞，撬开巨型贝壳收集分泌物。活很简单，报酬也不错。
en: The Islanders brought you into the karst cave, prying open giant shells to collect secretions. The work was simple, and the pay was not bad.
The pay's great, so join in

keys: 源石锭 -3，70% 获得源石锭 +8
en: Originium Ingot -3, 70% chance to obtain Originium Ingot +8

keys: 源石锭 -10，50% 获得源石锭 +25
en: Originium Ingot -10, 50% chance to gain Originium Ingot +25

keys: 你砍了几棵树皮光滑如皮肤的怪树当柴。入夜，篝火引来了不少迷路的旅人。
en: You chopped down a few strange trees with bark as smooth as skin for firewood. At nightfall, the campfire attracted many lost travelers.

keys: 源石锭 -5，获得一次成长三选一
en: Originium Ingot -5, choose 1 of 3 growth options

keys: 终端上有三条新委托，发件人是罗德岛驻伊比利亚的总负责人郁金香。每条末尾都附了一行小字。
en: Three new commissions appear on the terminal from Tulip, Rhodes Island's head of operations in Iberia. A line of fine print is attached to the end of each.
Take a look at the trickiest commission

keys: 接下来 90 秒刷出的敌人生命与伤害 +30%，并来一支精英小队。小队全灭且坚持到时间结束：主流派藏品三选一，源石锭 +15
en: Enemies spawned in the next 90s have HP and damage +30%, and an Elite squad will appear. Defeat the squad and survive until time ends: Choose 1 of 3 mainstream relics, Originium Ingot +15.

keys: 点开稍有挑战性的委托
en: Take a look at the mid-tier commission

keys: 接下来 90 秒刷出的敌人生命与伤害 +20%。坚持到时间结束：整局经验 +15%
en: Enemies spawned in the next 90s have HP and damage +20%. Survive until time ends: Run EXP +15%.
Take a look at the simplest commission

keys: 60 秒内击败 150 名敌人：源石锭 +10
一批支援物资送到了最近的安全屋。可以交给后勤部门转运，也可以派一名熟悉周边的干员去接。
en: A batch of support supplies has arrived at the nearest safehouse. You can leave it to the logistics department for transport, or dispatch an Operator familiar with the area to retrieve it.

keys: 选一名队友离队 45 秒；归队时该干员精英化一级，并带回一件主流派基础藏品
en: Select 1 squad member to leave the squad for 45s; upon returning, the Operator gains 1 Promotion level and brings back 1 main branch Basic relic

keys: 你找到了最初发出求助信号的罗德岛小队。他们也在探索周边，愿意和你交换情报。
en: You found the Rhodes Island squad that initially sent the distress signal. They were also exploring the surroundings and were willing to exchange intel with you.

keys: 选一名干员立即精英化一级（已精英二改为两次成长三选一）；再选一名队友随先遣小队撤离，离开编队，之后可再招募
en: Select an Operator for an immediate Promotion (if Elite 2, choose 1 of 3 growths twice instead); select another teammate to evacuate with the vanguard squad, leaving the squad, but can be recruited again later.

keys: 一位阿戈尔人捧着一件监测洋流的仪器，说它是秘宝。他想换一笔钱，去陆上最强大的国家。
en: An Ægir holds an ocean current monitoring device, claiming it is a relic. He wants to exchange it for money to travel to the most powerful nation on land.

keys: 消耗全部源石锭，获得一件主流派核心藏品
en: Lose all Originium Ingots, obtain a main branch Core Collectible

keys: 队长生命 -25%，获得一件主流派稀有藏品
en: Leader HP -25%, obtain a main branch Rare Collectible

keys: 你从恐鱼群里救下一个穿长袍的伊比利亚人。他捧出几只盒子答谢，你分不清他是教徒还是深海教徒。
en: You rescue a robed Iberian from a swarm of Sea Seaborn. He offers several boxes in gratitude. You cannot tell if he is a cleric or a Church of the Deep cultist.

keys: 选择印有剑与铳的盒子
en: Choose the box with a sword and gun

keys: 获得一件近战扩域 / 弱点收割 / 多弹火力藏品
en: Obtain a Melee Range Expansion / Weakness Harvesting / Multi-Projectile Firepower Collectible
Choose the box with a lantern

keys: 获得一件生存 / 护盾反击 / 治疗转伤藏品
en: Obtain a Survival / Objective Shield Counter / Healing-to-Damage Collectible

keys: 选择印有祈求双手的盒子
en: Choose the box with hands clasped in prayer

keys: 获得一件遭诅藏品，源石锭 +25
en: Obtain a Cursed Collectible, Originium Ingot +25

keys: 选择印有交错密钥的盒子
en: Choose the box with interlocking keys

keys: 获得一件遭诅藏品和一件主流派稀有藏品
en: Obtain a Cursed Collectible and a main branch Rare Collectible
Don't ask for anything in return

keys: 一位阿戈尔人把你带进避难所。窗外大雨，只有他手里的提灯亮着。架上摆着审判庭留下的装备，他愿意拿来换你带的东西。
en: An Ægir brings you into a shelter. Heavy rain falls outside; only the lantern in his hand is lit. Equipment left by the Inquisition sits on the shelves, which he is willing to trade for what you carry.

keys: 交出一件藏品（只能交纯属性藏品），从主流派亮出三件稀有度不低于它的藏品，选一件
en: Hand over 1 relic (stats-only relics only), reveal 3 main branch relics of equal or higher rarity, and choose 1

keys: 溶洞里，一位老工匠在保养两把比他还高的武器。他说阿戈尔已经没有猎人了，让你挑一把。
en: In a karst cave, an old Artificer maintains two weapons taller than himself. He says Ægir has no hunters left, and tells you to pick one.

keys: 获得一件近战扩域核心藏品
en: Obtain a Melee Range Expansion Core Collectible

keys: 获得一件弱点收割核心藏品
en: Obtain a Weakpoint Harvest Core Collectible

keys: 一队伊比利亚教士抬着火炉走过，炉里钉着一只还在扭动的恐鱼。为首的教士说，火焰能杀死所有海嗣。
en: A squad of Iberian clerics walks by carrying a furnace, inside which a writhing Sea Seaborn is nailed. The leading cleric states that fire can kill all Seaborn.

keys: 为受苦的干员请求火焰
en: Pray to the flames for your suffering operators

keys: 选一名干员立即精英化一级，队长最大生命 -10%
en: Promote 1 Operator immediately, Leader Max HP -10%

keys: 火焰拯救不了这片大地
下一个路口必出一张紧急作战，小队全灭掉两个宝箱
en: The next node is guaranteed to be an Emergency Operation, wipe out the enemy squad to drop two chests

keys: 立即来一支精英小队，全灭得主流派藏品三选一
en: Immediately face an Elite squad, defeat them to choose 1 of 3 main branch Collectibles

keys: 桌上摆着几件没人认领的东西。旧习俗说，路过的人可以带走一件。
en: Several unclaimed items lay on the table. An old custom says that passersby may Take one.

keys: 主流派藏品三选一（稀有 / 核心加权）
en: Choose 1 of 3 main branch Collectibles (Rare / Core weighted)

keys: 队长最大生命 -10%，主流派藏品三选一两次
en: Leader Max HP -10%, choose 1 of 3 main branch Collectibles twice

keys: 审判庭把苦修仪式和重体力活绑在了一起，完成的人能领到奖赏。来报名的人不少，走完的没几个。
en: The Inquisition has tied ascetic rituals to heavy manual labor, offering rewards to those who complete them. Many sign up, but few make it to the end.

keys: 队长生命 -12%，队长最大生命 +4%
将石料与燃料运上瞭望塔
en: Transport building materials and fuel to the watchtower

keys: 队长生命 -12%，获得一件主流派藏品
en: Leader HP -12%, obtain a main branch Collectible

keys: 迷雾把你送进一艘沉船的残骸。舱顶上站着一群同胞，它们在交谈，你听得出每个声音都不一样。
en: The fog sends you into the wreckage of a sunken ship. A group of kin stands on the cabin roof, conversing. You can hear that every voice is different.

keys: 源石锭 -10，远程杂兵开火间隔 +15%
en: Originium Ingot -10, ranged enemy attack interval +15%

keys: 队长最大生命 -5%，对精英伤害 +12%
en: Leader Max HP -5%, Damage to Elites +12%
Try to mingle in and join their conversation

keys: 神经损伤累积 +25%，全队技力回复 +8%
en: Nervous Impairment buildup +25%, squad SP Recovery +8%

keys: 你混进了一处深海教徒的聚居地。恐鱼和人在这里相安无事，前提是食物管够，也没人露出敌意。
en: You infiltrate a settlement of Church of the Deep cultists. Sea Seaborn and humans coexist peacefully here, provided there is enough food and no one shows hostility.

keys: 队长生命 -10%，再选喂哪一种
en: Leader HP -10%, then choose which to feed
It'd be best to leave now

keys: 食物备好了。水池边、浅滩上、洞穴深处，都有东西在等。
en: The food is ready. By the pool, in the Shallows, deep in the cave, things are waiting.
Feed the nethersea brand by the pool

keys: 招募一名干员（从随机两个职业里选）
en: Recruit an Operator (choose from 2 random classes)

keys: 队长生命 -10%，50% 再喂一次（只能再喂一次）
en: Leader HP -10%, 50% chance to feed again (can only feed one more time)

keys: 寻找信使驿站时，你遇到一位要回伊比利亚的教士。他愿意帮你联络当地的干员，但只负责联络。
en: While searching for a messenger station, you meet a cleric returning to Iberia. He is willing to help you contact local Operators, but only handles the communication.

keys: 源石锭 -5，招募一名干员（从随机两个职业里选）
en: Originium Ingot -5, recruit an Operator (choose from 2 random classes)

keys: 源石锭 -15，招募任意一名干员
一位老阿戈尔人在用恐鱼的尸体做装备。他说自己待过研究海嗣的科学院，现在只想让研究派上用场。
en: An old Ægir is crafting equipment from Sea Seaborn corpses. He says he once worked in an academy studying the Seaborn, and now only wants to put his research to use.
Why not give it a try?

keys: 获得一件生存 / 护盾反击稀有藏品；50% 同时获得一件遭诅藏品
en: Obtain 1 Survival / Shield Counter Rare relic; 50% chance to also obtain 1 Cursed relic
